verdict.rationale: Recurring automation is a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, which could plausibly offer things like scheduled recurring forwarding or automated mail-handling rules, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only on-demand requests (scan, forward, shred) and a one-off option to schedule a pickup day and time. That is an adjacent feature, not recurring jobs or workflows. Probes also found no API or OpenAPI spec, and nothing describes a recurring schedule or workflow engine.
